text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Shh... Must not disturb them NO-w... 
But... I can hardly contain my 
excitement... I cannot WAIT to 
celebrate...!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
*Gasp*!! No! It is nothing at aall! 
Please, continue your deep thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I cannot do that! Not when you look so 
eager to talk.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I can think to myself alone. But 
communication? Impossible! The time I 
spend with you is... a precious jewel.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now, tell me! What lies within your heart!
